owner_word: "Yes, bounded fix now" (owner, 2026-08-20), plus the variant-comparison plan: price A and B side by side, THE OWNER CHOOSES THE VARIANT AND GIVES THE ADOPTION WORD. This seat does NOT adopt, land, or flip the dial default, and the claims below are the machine-checkable half of that statement.
_why_small_act: SMALL-ACT IS THE HONEST SHAPE AND THE BORDERLINE IS NAMED RATHER THAN GLOSSED. Nothing VALUE-BEARING moves: the board, both copies, is byte-unmoved; so are the store, rl_model, the manifest, and every Guard-5-pinned fitted artifact. What DOES move is one engine SOURCE file (the dial, DEFAULT OFF) and the four identity carriers that name its md5 — expected_boot.engine_head, release_contract.identities.engine_head (+ the derived contract_sha256) and the two board_view_working.js stamps. Those are declared below as file_md5/json_field claims with their moved values, NOT hidden inside the unmoved list. A lever-landing claims file would be the wrong schema because no lever landed: no board moved, no lineage column was written, no dial default changed.
_note: THE CENTRAL CLAIM IS F1: with RL_O44_LVLMONO unset, the EDITED tree reproduces the live board 68be10c79d0ee096455754e084bcf757 BYTE-EXACT — dev twice (103.6s, 101.7s), canonical once (100.9s) — and the balanced sibling 556ad70d295923455982ae33e4b8bfd3 byte-exact (102.7s). See BUILD_F1_out.txt. The board_count claims below recompute the shipped board's own row count and value total from the artifact, so 'the board did not move' is checked as a number and not only as a hash. activation._doc: This act introduces exactly ONE switch and its day-0 state is OFF. There is no owner word activating it and none is claimed.

RL_O44_LVLMONO — the ORDER 44 level-axis._why: DEFAULT OFF, kill-switch semantics, five accepted values (off / ratchet / ratchet+conserve / smooth / smooth+conserve); any other value HALTS at import. It is DELIBERATELY NOT A MANIFEST DIAL — absent from data/model_config.json (byte-unmoved at 269d20ab, claimed below), so config_manifest.enforce() rejects it as an unknown model override in bake/gate/canonical mode and NO CERTIFYING BUILD CAN CARRY IT. Turning it on is the owner's word to give and it has not been given. The dial_coverage acceptance check counts it as REPORTED, NOT GATED.

the day-0 reference regeneration (DAY0_S._why: It is THIS ACT'S OWN base reference, used only to measure the two candidate emits against a same-clock base. It SUPERSEDES NOTHING: docs/evidence/final_candidate_2026-08-19/DAY0_CP.json is byte-unaltered and un-repointed, no script's default RL_DAY0_FINAL is changed, and the standing regeneration the R23 advance owes is referred to a round-advance seat in the packet, not performed here.

ORDER 44 itself._why: CLASSIFIED FOR RETIREMENT AT THE VARIANT-C REBAKE (owner-scheduled post-R24), and its removal is a rebake MUST-MOVE PROOF. The fix is scaffolding over a defect that lives at the FIT; FIX 1 (monotonic_cst on feature 9) retires the whole dial. Declared in the prereg before the scaffold was erected.
